claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says bodily limits and the memory veil create ego and death fear by obscuring broader soul consciousness.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says psychological pain can persist after death and prompt reincarnation; suicide does not escape it.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says postmortem focus shapes experience: trauma or guilt may create a lower-astral state, but souls are not objectively trapped; ghosts may be echoes or time anomalies.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says experience and interpretation build the soul; heaven and hell are self-created states, not destinations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

review_flags: Mari Swaruu presents different possible outcomes after death as depending on the individual’s perception and outlook.
